title: Slips and the T1
blurb: Read a T4, a T4A and a T5, and the parts of a tax return.

levels.title: Reading a T4
learn: Say what a T4 shows and what its main boxes mean.
Check the CPP and EI on a T4 against the 2025 rates.

cards.text: At the end of the year your employer gives you a T4. It shows what you earned and what was taken off your pay: CPP, EI and income tax. The amounts are for the whole year, not one paycheque.

image.alt: A blank slip in an envelope beside a tied stack of blank pay slips

cards.text: Priya is a line cook at Maple Street Grill. She worked all twelve months of 2025. Here is her T4. The amounts are made up for 2025. Each line is a numbered box.
Boxes 24 and 26 hold the pay used to work out EI and CPP. For Priya they equal box 14. Box 16A is the second, additional CPP, called CPP2. Priya's box 16A is $0.

image.alt: Two blank slips tied to one tall stack of gold discs

cards.text: CPP in box 16: for 2025 the rate is 5.95% of pay above a yearly exemption of $3,500. Priya worked the full year, so her CPP is 5.95% of ($27,500 - $3,500) = 5.95% of $24,000 = $1,428.

image.alt: Two labelled jars and a ruler beside a tall stack of gold discs

cards.text: EI in box 18: for 2025 the rate is 1.64% of insurable earnings (box 24), up to $65,700. For Priya, 1.64% of $27,500 = $451.

image.alt: A calendar of twelve squares with an equal stack of gold discs in each

cards.text: Box 22 is the income tax the employer took off during the year. Priya's $1,420 is a made-up amount. Your own pay stub in the game shows the same kinds of deductions: gross pay, CPP, EI and income tax. Open the Job Centre and find them.

image.alt: A counter with a blank pay stub under a magnifying glass beside gold discs

levels.title: Other slips: T4A and T5
learn: Tell a T4, a T4A and a T5 apart.
Read the box on a T5 and the amounts on slips.

cards.text: A T4 is for pay. Other income comes on other slips. A T4A is a slip for other kinds of income that are not pay from an employer. A T5 is a slip from a bank for the interest your savings earned.

image.alt: Three blank coloured slips fanned out beside a piggy bank and a work apron

cards.text: The three slips side by side. Each one reports a different kind of income.

figure.title: Three slips
rows: Pay from an employer, and what came off it
Other income, not pay from an employer

cards.text: Priya also has a T5. Box 13 on a T5 is interest from Canadian sources. Her savings earned $63.50 this year. The amount is made up.
Marcus worked at a coffee shop for five months, so he has a T4. He also has a T4A slip for other income: $300. The amount is made up. On his T4A, box 028 is Other income.

image.alt: A coffee cup on a cafe counter with a blank slip tucked under it

cards.text: Each kind of income has its own boxes. On a T4A, box 105 is for scholarships, fellowships, bursaries, and artists' project grants. It goes on line 13010 of the return.

image.alt: A blank certificate and a scroll on a desk beside an empty notebook

cards.text: Amara changed jobs in July. Two employers means two T4s, one from each. She also has a T5 from her bank. Here are her slips.

levels.title: The T1 and what you need to file
learn: Name the main lines of a T1 in order.
List what a person gathers to file, and add up total income.

cards.text: The T1 is the income tax return a person files each year. It is a form of numbered lines. The slips tell you what to write: T4 box 14 goes on line 10100. These line numbers are from the 2025 return.

image.alt: An open blank form with empty boxes beside a tray of blank slips

cards.text: The first lines of the return, in order. Income comes first, then deductions, then net income and taxable income.

Total income is all the income on your slips, added up. A deduction is subtracted from it, such as an RRSP contribution. Taxable income is what is left after the deductions. Tax is worked out on taxable income.

image.alt: A short ladder with a gold disc on each step and a ruler beside it

cards.text: Then come the credits, which lower your tax, then your net federal tax. T4 box 22 goes on line 43700. The last line is a refund or a balance owing. The lines in order:

figure.title: Credits, tax and result
rows: Base CPP or QPP contributions through employment income

cards.text: Start by gathering your documents to report income and claim deductions. Your information slips show the income paid to you and the deductions withheld from it. With a paper return, include one copy of each information slip.

image.alt: A desk with an open folder of blank slips and receipts, a clipboard and an envelope

cards.text: Priya's pile has three documents. The T4 and the T5 are income. The RRSP receipt backs up a deduction on line 20800, so it is not income. Total income is the income on the slips added up.

questions.label: Total income line
questions.prompt: On the T1, which line is total income?
questions.hint: Look at the first table.

options.why: Line 10100 is employment income, one part of total income.
Yes. Line 15000 is total income.
Line 23600 is net income, after deductions.
Line 26000 is taxable income, after deductions.

questions.label: RRSP line
questions.prompt: Which line is the RRSP deduction?
questions.hint: The line name says RRSP.

options.why: Line 15000 is total income, before deductions.
Line 26000 is taxable income.
Line 43700 is the total income tax deducted.
Yes. Line 20800 is the RRSP deduction.

questions.label: Tax deducted line
questions.prompt: T4 box 22 is income tax already deducted from pay. Which line of the T1 is total income tax deducted?

figure.title: Credits, tax and result
rows: Base CPP or QPP contributions through employment income

questions.hint: Look at the second table.

options.why: Yes. Line 43700 is the total income tax deducted.
Line 42000 is net federal tax, the tax you owe.
Line 48400 is the refund.
Line 48500 is the balance owing.

questions.label: Refund line
questions.prompt: Which line of the T1 is the refund?

figure.title: Credits, tax and result
rows: Base CPP or QPP contributions through employment income

terms.meaning: Money the government pays back to you when the tax withheld is more than the tax you owe.

questions.hint: The refund and the balance owing are the last two lines.

options.why: Line 48500 is the balance owing, the opposite result.
Line 42000 is net federal tax.
Yes. Line 48400 is the refund.
Line 43700 is the total income tax deducted.

questions.prompt: On which line of the T1 does a T4's box 14 go?
questions.hint: Box 14 is employment income.

options.why: Line 12100 is interest and other investment income.
Yes. T4 box 14, employment income, goes on line 10100.
Line 15000 is total income, the sum of all the income lines.
Line 43700 is the tax already deducted, from box 22.

questions.prompt: What is Priya's RRSP receipt used for?

options.text: To add to her total income
options.why: A deduction lowers income. The receipt is not income.

options.why: That is the T4, box 22.

options.text: To back up her RRSP deduction
